messages:
alice_support: Hey team, opening an escalation from a customer on Dedicated. They bundled our TypeScript SDK in an Edge Function and are seeing repeated 401s + automatic retries that blew up their token usage. Repro steps attached by the customer below.

carl_customer: repro steps -> build with webpack (next edge), bundle includes our SDK 1.3.0. On cold start, first request returns 401, client retries (default 3) and every retry also gets 401. Result: client sends 4 requests per user request, ~4x billing. Logs: 
```
> 401 Unauthorized: invalid_api_key
> at request (/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.cjs:45:12)
> at internal/retry-loop.js:23:9
```

alice_support: Thanks @carl_customer. We need a minimal repro we can run locally. Did the bundle resolve to CJS or ESM? Any tsconfig / package.json flags?

carl_customer: bundle manifest shows main -> dist/index.js (CommonJS), but TS types point at dist/index.esm.d.ts. package.json has conditional exports ("./": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }). They didn't include a .d.ts path in exports, so types resolution via tsconfig path maps to ESM variant in their tooling.

mark_sdk: @alice_support thanks for tagging. I think this is the edge-case we discussed: some bundlers (Next Edge / Vercel) will prefer the "import" field for ESM resolution in production builds while local tsc resolves types differently. When auth code path detects header shape mismatch it treats as non-retryable, but due to how our runtime wrapper was compiled to cjs/esm interop we accidentally normalize the 401 as transient. That triggers the retry loop.

emma_eng: Quick checklist: 1) Can you share the exact package.json + webpack/next config? 2) Which Node runtime on the Edge (Node 18/20)? 3) Is the customer using the SDK with default retry config?

carl_customer: package.json snippet: 
```
{
  "name": "app-x",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood/sdk": "^1.3.0"
  }
}
```
next.config.js: 
```
module.exports = {
  experimental: { serverComponents: true },
  webpack: (cfg) => { cfg.resolve = cfg.resolve || {}; cfg.resolve.fullySpecified = false; return cfg; }
};
```
Node runtime: Vercel Edge (Chromium-based), default SDK retries.

mark_sdk: Repro notes from my side: I can reproduce with a small Next Edge function when bundling @redwood/sdk@1.3.0 with webpack 5 + type: "module" set. The runtime ends up importing the cjs file but typedefs point at the esm build; some build-time transforms wrap the auth header logic and change instanceof checks.

mark_sdk: Quick mitigation: have the customer set REDWOOD_SDK_MAX_RETRIES=0 in their env to avoid the billing spike while we patch. Also ask them to pin package to 1.2.9 which doesn't have the dual-entry conditional that caused the mismatch.

alice_support: Can we ship a patch? This is an escalator from a paying Dedicated customer.

emma_eng: Yes. Root cause: missing explicit types export along with conditional exports caused bundlers/ts to pick different entrypoints. That plus an interop wrapper changed error classification. Proposed fix: publish 1.3.1 that adds explicit exports for types and ensures the auth error detection path is invariant across CJS/ESM builds. Example package.json exports patch: 
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This forces bundlers and tsc to resolve the same surface for runtime and types.

mark_sdk: Also adding a runtime guard: if response.status === 401 and body.code === 'invalid_api_key' then treat as auth-failure (no retries). We currently inspect error class that got lost in interop. I'll open PR to normalize based on status/body.

deploy-bot: release/ts-sdk@1.3.1 created by mark_sdk (PR #452). CI: pending.

alice_support: Great — can we get a temporary workaround for the customer while PR lands?

mark_sdk: Yes: 1) Set REDWOOD_SDK_MAX_RETRIES=0 2) Or force their bundler to prefer the require entrypoint by adding in their webpack config: 
```
resolve: {
  mainFields: ['main', 'module']
}
```
This will prefer cjs main over module field.

carl_customer: Trying REDWOOD_SDK_MAX_RETRIES=0 now. Will report back in ~10 minutes.

emma_eng: Action items: - mark_sdk: finish PR to normalize auth detection + add types export (ETA: today). - support: get customer to set env var and pin to 1.2.9 if they need immediate rollback. - releng: publish 1.3.1 and notify customer.

alice_support: Thanks everyone. Carl please ping if you still see retries after env var change. :thumbsup:
